name: how-to-make-ai-video
description: How to make AI video skills for Claude Code and AI agents: one search over varg how to (varg.ai/how-to, 2,000+ checked AI video skills, step-by-step how-to tutorials, FFmpeg recipes, video formats, prompts and styles) turns a video request into the best skill with its install command, the 2-4 options to show the person (with example videos) and the steps. Use when someone asks "how do I make a ... video", "make me a UGC ad / lyric video / explainer / talking avatar / product video / faceless short", "make a whole film / launch video from scratch" (production order across skills), "add captions", "edit this video", "which skill should I use for ...", "find a skill for ...", or the same in any language, and no installed skill already covers that format; use it before writing a video pipeline from scratch or searching registries. Also use it to list a video skill you built on varg how to. Not for running a generation itself (use varg-ai), and not for non-media coding tasks.
